synthesizedFacts.fact: Lip exfoliation involves removing dead skin cells to improve lip texture and appearance.
The skin on the lips is thinner and lacks oil glands, making it prone to dryness and chapping.
Mechanical exfoliation uses physical particles to remove dead skin, while chemical exfoliation uses acids or enzymes.
Over-exfoliation can lead to irritation and damage to the lips.
